tests/grader/spec.json base_key_parameters requires 'clip_wall_thickness = 2.1 mm' (this is the base_wall construction parameter). freecad_validator's cad_spec_consistency pass reads this literal string as authoritative for the Base state.
tests/grader/spec.json base_key_parameters requires 'clip_width = 5.5 mm' — the same clip_width value is preserved into the Edit state key_parameters (unchanged).
tests/grader/spec.json base_key_parameters requires 'tab_transition_arc_radius = 4.4 mm'; carried unchanged into the Edit key_parameters.
tests/grader/spec.json base_key_parameters requires 'tip_fillet_radius = 1.9 mm'; carried unchanged into the Edit key_parameters.
tests/grader/spec.json base_key_parameters requires 'tip_line_angle = 40 deg'; carried unchanged into the Edit key_parameters.

tests/grader/spec.json key_parameters (Edit state) requires 'clip_wall_thickness = 2.65 mm' — this is the target of the base→edit wall-thickness change. spec.json edit_instruction reads 'change clip_wall_thickness'.
The instruction contract requires base_opening = 18.4 mm in the Edit state (was 15.8 mm in Base). Edit-state geometry recomputes through this value.

tests/grader/spec.json mode = 'create_and_edit' — both Base and Edit states must be produced by the same construction method (this is what run_scorer.py's twin validate_pass invocations check by design).
must_include: create_and_edit mode, same construction method for both states

must_include: closed non-self-intersecting analytic tangent curve chain
rounded transition, connector root, explicit root selection, deep closed retention topology
declared Base-to-Edit operator preserving the native dependency chain

requirements.verifier_assertion: The instruction (Coordinate System section) and Freecad Dependency section fix the Pad convention: Midplane = true, Reversed = false, Length = pad_depth. The solid is centered about the sketch plane. This is what freecad_validator's geometry_similarity pass compares against the reference FCStd.

The instruction's Branch Policy section fixes the connector-tangent branch: right connector tangent solved first from p4 to c_conn_r; lower-Y root (with greater-X tiebreak), which is the positive lower-intersection root; left tangent mirrored as t_l = (-t_r.x, t_r.y); tip arc branch is inner-to-outer. Geometry_similarity depends on the selected branch.
must_include: solve the right connector tangent first from p4 to c_conn_r

requirements.verifier_assertion: The instruction states 'All other measurable and construction parameters remain as declared' for the Edit state. spec.json base_key_parameters and key_parameters differ only in clip_wall_thickness; every other public parameter must be preserved end-to-end.
must_include: Every other measurable and construction parameter stays as declared for Base
